dog.description_text: Meet Sookie — New Arrival! Sookie just arrived at the adoption center and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQBAApwa4Z2uQ4ECXqrVXmNEAQNqoEuwXht3_IVDT4-a_Eg?e=mA2mID Sookie is a 2 year old calico girl. Her foster says " It’s been only five days since we met, and she’s already so much more comfortable around us and in the house! She takes a little while to warm up, but once she feels safe, she becomes the sweetest kitty. She loves taking long naps with us and absolutely adores cuddles and nonstop pets! she is so cuddly and sweet. She’ll lay down with you for a long time if you keep petting her." Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
